purpose: Legacy single-App blueprint retained only as a migration marker. Production ANPOS commercial deployments must separate the customer-facing Marketplace GitHub App from the private Vendor Distribution GitHub App.
reason: A Marketplace App must be public/installable by customers, while vendor private-template delivery may require repository permissions that customers must never be asked to grant. A single App registration collapses these trust boundaries.
migration_rule: Do not configure GITHUB_APP_ID or GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY for new production deployments. Configure distinct GITHUB_MARKETPLACE_APP_* and GITHUB_VENDOR_APP_* credentials and verify /api/ready passes role-separation checks.
security_requirements: Marketplace and Vendor App IDs must be different.
Marketplace and Vendor App private keys must not be reused.
Vendor template Administration permission must never be granted to the customer-facing Marketplace App merely for vendor-side collaborator provisioning.
This deprecated file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
